notes: ARISTOTLE. Served HR 0.69 (0.60-0.80) matches the abstract and registry OUTCOME 3 ANALYSIS 0 ('Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.69 (95% CI 0.60 to 0.80)'). Major bleeding is ISTH-defined (registry OUTCOME 2/3 description). Served analysis_set is null; the registry states the bleeding analysis used treated participants during the treatment period (first dose to 2 days after last dose; mean exposure 1.7 y), not ITT. The analysis_set span text (description tail + time frame + population) occurs for both registry OUTCOME 2 and OUTCOME 3, which are the same major-bleeding endpoint, so the two occurrences are equivalent. Registry counts: 327/9088 apixaban vs 462/9052 warfarin with major bleeding. Follow-up span (1.8 y median) is overall trial follow-up; bleeding estimate applies to the on-treatment period.
